timestamp_basis: Actual decoded video PTS multiplied by time_base; seconds from video start. No archive offset applied.
review_method: Manual inspection of original-color source frames sampled at 8fps; first two recipient onsets inspected at20fps. Independent of archive event counts.
contact_definition: First pale pointed ring / blue-white glints on Melmetal head/neck followed by descending points, after a distinct rising-heart sequence around Gardevoir. This is a visible contact effect, not a claim of server damage timestamp.
not_counted: White expanding touch rings are user input, not attacks.
Purple shadow aura remains active during settled idle.
Repeated hearts within one animation are one cycle, not separate attacks.
Recipient idle bobbing and reactive movement are not independently counted as attacks.
limits: Opening two attack blocks only; not a full-match count.
Contact animation onset can differ from HP depletion or evidence publication time.
Some source frames are variable-rate; labels use actual PTS, not frame index or nominal FPS.
Most onset brackets are about0.1–0.15s; first two tighter.
No audio stream in supplied MP4; does not establish whether Overdex archive audio exists.
Existing first-/second-/transition- sheets crop at y610 and can clip the HP top border. Use hp-first- sheets/full frame for HP inspection.

subsequent_user_clarification.description: Roughly the first third of Gardevoir Fast Move animation repeated rapidly for at least one regular Charm duration.
subsequent_user_clarification.count_interpretation: Labels count completed visual cycles, not independent server-registered attacks. Do not count partial restarts or infer no underlying attacks from stuttering alone.
subsequent_user_clarification.reported_missing_content: Match result; duration is approximate user recollection.
subsequent_user_clarification.last_frame_observation: Battle continues against Garchomp with HP remaining; no result screen.
